name: Mermaids
overview: The Bible references great sea creatures such as Leviathan, described as a powerful serpent or dragon in the sea, symbolizing chaos and evil that God will ultimately defeat (Isaiah 27:1; Job 41:1). While mermaids as mythical beings are not directly mentioned, the Scriptures affirm God's sovereignty over all creation, including the sea and its creatures (Judges 16:23). Believers are called to submit to God and resist evil, trusting in His deliverance and salvation through Christ (John 3:16; James 4:7).
